verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show a way to bring existing, unmanaged OCI resources under IaC, and it documents no drift detection. The only import evidence is migrating an existing Terraform state file into Resource Manager, which covers resources already under Terraform. The existence of the Terraform provider alone is a building block, not an import or drift workflow.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, existing resources can come under IaC — documented import/drift workflows instead of a greenfield-only story
